principles.statement: Grant only the minimum access needed to perform a task, nothing more.

Check every access to every object, every time.
Require more than one condition or party to authorize sensitive actions.
Data and systems are accessible to authorized users when needed.
Information is accessible only to those authorized to have access.
Data is accurate, complete, and protected from unauthorized alteration.
